objective: Attempt strict direct source-argument-preserving AssertionCarrier v2 composition for all 68 frozen self-target ClaimIR relations. Separate formal schema typing compatibility, semantic entailment/epistemic precision and demonstrated FULL preservation; no posthoc carrier vocabulary is allowed.
strict_direct_rules: An F1 DIRECT FULL requires a concrete v2 record with exactly the frozen source_kind and ordered source_arguments, declared v2 predicate family and licensed qualifiers/modifiers, all source arguments typed without changing their Stage-D layer, all necessary semantic references admitted from existing frozen ClaimIR nodes, and independently discriminating adversarial semantic contrasts. A paper-specific source node name or explanatory prose cannot substitute for an absent core semantic operator.

The frozen v2 permits argument binding layers L_sys/L_ctx/L_claim but not L_formal. Treat any Stage-D L_formal original argument as STRICT_TYPED_LAYER_MISMATCH unless a separately defended lossless encoding under declared v2 types is supplied without changing architecture semantics.

A Stage-D L_claim argument may be bound under frozen v2 only if it is already explicitly typed THEORETICAL_ACCOUNT. Neither a measured result, a methodology step, a validation status, nor the scientific assertion itself can be silently relabeled as a theoretical account.
semantic_references can carry existing ClaimIR nodes omitted from source arguments, not manufacture new predicate families or change source argument-layer rules.

Qualifier NEGATIVE does not automatically differentiate proposition falsity, absence of evidence, absence of entailment, and non-establishment. These are separate adversarial semantic obligations. DECLARED scope does not substitute for central non-entailment or epistemic status predicates.
The 63 Stage-D descriptive semantic operator tags are audit annotations, NOT automatically permitted v2 predicate families.
A success in v2 retrospective AHV-8 calibration cannot be reused as independent F1 validation of these 47 paper-meta claims.

F1 direct failures are failures under this strict no-retyping/no-free-text-completion contract, not mathematical impossibility theorems for all logics, nor proof of any missing top-level cognitive-system role or new layer.
Report both relation incidence and unique cases; a relation may exhibit more than one blocker. Do not count all untested relations as demonstrated GAP.

judgments.STRICT_TYPED_LAYER_MISMATCH: At least one original source argument has the frozen Stage-D L_formal type, which frozen v2 cannot bind directly.
judgments.STRICT_CLAIM_OBJECT_TYPE_NOT_LICENSED: A required Stage-D L_claim argument is a non-theoretical research object, not the sole v2-permitted theoretical-account claim-object type.
judgments.SEMANTIC_DISTINCTION_WITNESS: A documented contrast requires a distinction not explicitly available in declared predicate/qualifier/modifier semantics; no injective direct witness has been demonstrated.
judgments.SCHEMA_ADMISSIBLE_SEMANTIC_UNTESTED: All checked formal type constraints pass but no concrete v2 record plus full adversarial semantic distinction witness has been demonstrated.
judgments.FULL_STRICT_DIRECT: An explicit v2 record with validated type bindings and semantic disambiguation under this precommitted strict test, not a truth claim.

proof_obligation: Do not fabricate FULL records or infer global impossible encodability. For each detected structural blocker, report relation IDs and frozen source bound-layer witnesses. For semantic blockers, identify a concrete original relation/contrast and unavailable typed semantic distinction; otherwise mark untested.
output: Separate deterministic 68-relation type audit from independently reasoned semantic adversarial witness review. Declare typed-blocker counts precisely, list semantic witnesses as provisional unless adversarial preservation checked. Keep F2 independently blind reconstruction not performed.
